text.tspan: Functional schematic. Switch blades shown in RUN; open crosses are intentionally unconnected terminals.
One total 5.1k per CC pin; do not duplicate fitted Rd.
RUN: system on; charging input open.
CHARGE: system off; USB feeds charger.
Replace the existing RPROG with 3.0k (IC pin 2 PROG to pin 3 GND); expected 367-400mA, measure actual.
PGND = OUT-/IN-; only the cell negative goes to B-. Booster stays attached and consumes idle current.
Use the external inlet to charge. Charger native USB stays unused. Programming USB: CHARGE first; unplug before RUN.
